rerank.novel_reasoning: No candidate template covers the defining characteristics of this problem: (1) large-scale metric learning with Sub-center ArcFace Loss for open-set landmark identification across 5M+ images; (2) Domain-Adversarial Training (DANN) to explicitly bridge the professional-photo vs. mobile-upload covariate shift; (3) CLIP-based foundation model fine-tuning as the backbone initialization strategy; (4) Stochastic Weight Averaging for generalization across a long-tailed class distribution. The problem is best framed as a retrieval/metric-learning competition (similar to Google Landmark Recognition), and none of the five candidates instantiate that paradigm. A novel template should combine: CLIP backbone fine-tuning → Sub-center ArcFace head → DANN domain discriminator → balanced oversampling per-class → multi-scale training → SWA → gallery-index retrieval ensemble.
